ChoiceText.SourceString: Norton Rhodes thinks Charles is cheating people. What do you think?
ChoiceText.LocalizedString: Norton Rhodes thinks Charles is cheating people. What do you think?

CompletionText.SourceString: Sambor Ogden was far more direct in his accusations. He called Charles a swindler and claimed he’s been overcharging villagers for years. Sambor also hinted that Charles might have accomplices helping him inflate prices or smuggle in cheap books. He confirmed Norton’s suspicions but added that Charles’s status as the only book merchant in the village makes it difficult for anyone to challenge him.
